description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension and rear roof dormer extension, insertion of a front roof light and replacement of the house's existing double glazed windows and front door.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (051-0013 (Rev C); 051-0020 (Rev B)  Received:  21 March 2022;  051-0000; 051-0005; 051-0006; 051-0010 (Rev A); 051-0011 (Rev B); 051-0012 (Rev B); 051-0021 (Rev C); 051-0030 (Rev B); 051-0031 (Rev B)  Received:  10 December 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey rear infill extension and rear roof dormer extension hereby approved.
